description: Real SEC 10-Q filing-pair benchmark scaffold with source-traceable company and accession metadata plus candidate annotation records for human review.
limitations: Initial version stores SEC identifiers, pair metadata, and candidate labels only; full filing text is reconstructed explicitly from SEC sources when needed.
No candidate annotation in this dataset is a gold or approved label until a human reviewer marks it approved with review metadata.
Standard CI must remain offline and deterministic; live SEC refresh is a separate explicit workflow.
